Oxygenated and donor-rich examples were mixed: ff3ee95fed58907ff8b3 and fea75df17d0bf593243f showed strong completion overprediction, while f4e1a820726cf8f5d4e2 and 55d368396013c3c895c3 were much closer. The large errors for 2b97a1e0a6a4b944b760, d1172a49fca1e196a59f, 902937db42f82f467718, 49201b5817f204116f7f, and 9ed7c1fb1c2cc499bbf9 support measuring local condition-response curves and targeted heteroatom transitions rather than increasing a global polarity adjustment.","batch_rationale":"The batch concentrates several meaningful local experiments: m78 and m107 span condition and loading changes around measured late-tail failures; m13, m125, m135, m119, m205, and m60 extend oxygenated response curves; m197, m118, m110, m145, and m77 repair endpoint-specific aldehyde and ether/ester behavior; and m141, m146, m216, m211, m212, m160, m161, m202, and m199 explore nitrogen-rich, charged, and sulfur regimes with intermediate controls. The selected high supplied quantile widths identify model-failure regions, while paired family points reduce redundancy and help distinguish structural effects from condition effects. This combination should improve V1 and V2 generalization across both common neutral rows and the smaller but high-error polar and heteroatom regimes."}
